summary: Manage car traffic by building roads and cities in this highway simulator game
description:
Build motorways between cities for cars to drive, solve traffic problems and earn more points to carry out even more transportation. Play State Connect to bridge all the new states territory together. 

This connection game is very easy to control and incredibly enjoyable to play. A huge number of different options for the road construction of transit systems. To build a highway - just slide your finger from one point to another and the movement will begin! Don't forget to upgrade your cities to create even more freeways and take over the world! State Connect will make you feel like a real road manager and transport planner who can conquer world domination!

Game features:
 - Strategic traffic and route planning simulation
 - Satisfying idle map with many cars moving at once
 - Addictive gameplay                       
 - Dozens of levels
 - Smooth animations and lively colors
 - Simple and intuitive controls
 - Exciting gaming session

More than a hundred cities and even more highways. Plan, construct and create a road system in the city that this games world has never seen! Connect every state territory across the map and become a transport tycoon! Download State Connect and play this idle management simulation game for free.
